title: SAFETY SENTRY: Context-Aware Human Intervention via EXECUTE-ASK-REFUSE Routing
abstract: arXiv:2607.13594v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: LLM agents act on real-world environments through tool calls, and a single misjudged action can cause irreversible harm. The standard safeguard is a guard model that labels each proposed action as safe or unsafe, but this binary view conflates two distinct decisions: whether the action is harmful in itself, and whether it is appropriate given the user's context. It also operates at the granularity of action categories rather than individual instances, producing routine interruptions that erode autonomy and train users to wave through the most consequential alerts. translated_title: 安全哨兵：通过执行-询问-拒绝路由实现上下文感知的人类干预
translated_abstract: LLM 智能体通过工具调用作用于真实世界环境，一次误判的动作就可能造成不可逆的伤害。标准的安全防护手段是由守卫模型将每个提议的动作标记为安全或不安全，但这种二元视角混淆了两个不同的决策：动作本身是否有害，以及在用户的上下文中该动作是否合适。此外，它还在动作类别而非单个实例的粒度上运作，产生大量例行中断，侵蚀用户自主性，并训练用户对最关键的警报也习惯性地放行。我们将该问题重新表述为针对每个实例的三方路由决策 {EXECUTE, ASK, REFUSE}，并通过 Safety Sentry（安全哨兵）来实现——一个轻量级守卫模型，其推理仅需单次解码调用。只需一个解码时阈值，即可让一个固定的模型检查点在不同风险容忍度的部署之间重新定位，无需重新训练。Safety Sentry 的性能超越……（原文摘要截断于此）
tldr: 该论文提出轻量级守卫模型 Safety Sentry，将 LLM 智能体的动作安全检查从二元的“安全/不安全”判断重新定义为针对每个实例的执行-询问-拒绝三方路由决策，仅需单次解码调用和一个解码时阈值，即可在不重训练的情况下适配不同风险容忍度的部署场景。
en_tdlr: Safety Sentry is a lightweight guard model that reframes LLM agent action safety from binary safe/unsafe classification into a per-instance three-way routing decision over {EXECUTE, ASK, REFUSE}, requiring only a single decoding call and one decoding-time threshold to adapt a fixed checkpoint across deployments with different risk tolerances without retraining.
